developmental_history: Down syndrome (trisomy 21) diagnosed at birth by karyotype. Global developmental delay noted in infancy: walked at 30 months, first words at age 3. WISC-IV 2008 (age 12): FSIQ 48; WAIS-IV 2015 (age 19): FSIQ 51, moderate intellectual disability. Special education through age 21.
hpi: Annual physical / pre-admission H&P for ICF/IID placement. Last generalized tonic-clonic seizure 03/2026 (~2 min); averages 1-2/year on levetiracetam. Uses CPAP nightly. No recent illness, hospitalizations or ER visits in the past year. Needs verbal cues and supervision for bathing, dressing and hygiene.
past_history: Secundum ASD surgical repair 1997. Tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy 2002. Epilepsy since 2009. Hypothyroidism since 2012. OSA on CPAP since 2020.
social_history: Lives with mother/legal guardian (age 68), whose health is declining; she can no longer provide 24-hour supervision. Attends a day habilitation program 5 days/week. Family requesting ICF/IID placement through DDA.
environmental: Wanders and has poor safety awareness; needs supervision near traffic, water and the stove.
exam_general: Short stature; features of trisomy 21 (upslanting palpebral fissures, flat nasal bridge, single palmar crease).
exam_head_eyes_neck: Epicanthal folds, Brushfield spots. Neck supple, thyroid not enlarged.
exam_heart: RRR, no murmur; healed sternotomy scar.
exam_skin: Dry skin, mild xerosis of hands.
exam_neuro: CN II-XII grossly intact; mild generalized hypotonia; broad-based but steady gait; strength 5/5 throughout.
recommendations: Continue levetiracetam 750 mg BID, levothyroxine 100 mcg daily, vitamin D.
TSH every 6 months; annual audiology and ophthalmology.
Supervision near water, traffic and stove; weight management.
